entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single transparent PNG building sprite for a cozy cartoon farm game. A small charming farm hut, simple terracotta orange pitched roof, cream plaster and honey wood walls, one round window, wooden door, small leaf emblem above the door and a single vegetable basket beside it. Clean minimal cute design, broad readable shapes, neat warm brown outlines and soft dimensional hand-painted shading. Front view with slight top view, no isometric diamond. Compact narrow building designed for a single square footprint. Entire roof and base visible, centered, tiny transparent margin. No surrounding landscape, no characters, no text, no watermark, no cast shadow, true transparent background.
